# Coffee With Bro — Full Architecture & Documentation for LLMs

> Real-time, 100% offline American Sign Language (ASL) to written text recognition system built with React, Spring Boot, and DeepLearning4j.

Course: UCS503 Software Engineering  
Institution: Department of Computer Science & Engineering, Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology  
Academic Year: 2026–2027 (Odd Semester, 5th Semester)  

## Table of Contents
1. Executive Summary & Purpose
2. Privacy & Offline Engineering Model
3. Directory & Module Blueprint
4. Network Protocol & WebSocket Specification
5. Deep Learning & CNN Architecture
6. Dataset & Preprocessing Pipeline
7. Frontend Architecture & State Management
8. Software Verification & Quality Assurance

---

### 1. Executive Summary & Purpose
Coffee With Bro translates live webcam hand gestures into written sentences completely offline. The motivation stems from personal privacy: standard computer vision APIs upload continuous camera frames to commercial cloud providers. Coffee With Bro processes video entirely in local memory on the user's host machine.

### 2. Privacy & Offline Engineering Model
- Zero Cloud APIs: Neither Google Cloud, AWS Rekognition, nor external models are queried.
- Memory Deallocation: Webcam video frames converted to base64 snapshots are resized to 128x128 in JVM RAM, classified, and instantly garbage collected.
- Zero Tracking: Zero advertising scripts, zero analytics cookies, and zero telemetry.

### 3. Directory Blueprint
- `coffee_with_bro/`: Spring Boot Java 17 backend hosting DeepLearning4j CNN at `/ws/echo`.
- `milk_with_bro/`: React 19, TypeScript, and Vite single-page application with webcam viewfinder and transcript buffer.
- `ice_with_bro/`: Python 3.10+ data preparation suite for landmark extraction (MediaPipe) and CNN baseline training (PyTorch).
- `cream_with_bro/`: Coursework artifacts including IEEE 830 SRS, UML diagrams, and LaTeX reports.
- `sugar_with_bro/`: Native HTML5/JavaScript WebSocket test client for isolated backend verification.

### 4. WebSocket Protocol
- Endpoint: `ws://localhost:8080/ws/echo`
- Frame Payload: Base64-encoded JPEG image string (`data:image/jpeg;base64,...`) sent every 350ms.
- Inference Response: JSON payload formatted as:
  ```json
  {
    "label": "A",
    "confidence": 0.942
  }
  ```

### 5. Neural Network Specifications
- Supported Classes: 36 static ASL characters (A-Z, 0-9).
- Input Matrix: 128x128x3 RGB normalized values.
- Framework: DeepLearning4j 1.0.0-M2.1 with ND4J execution backend.
